product_one_liner.value: Trusaic provides pay-equity analysis, equitable pay-decision tools, and pay-transparency compliance software for global enterprises.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the public navigation or footer; no public pricing page was located.

founded_year.notes: 1999 is the founding year of predecessor First Capitol Consulting, which evolved into Trusaic.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains regulatory, product and marketing content; it does not establish two product-build posts authored by engineers.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link was found in the navigation or footer; the Trust Center lists security and integration documents rather than a public multi-article product help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A careers page exists, but its readable content does not expose the current requisition list. Located data-scientist listings were expired, so neither a live opening nor a complete negative could be verified.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or model provider was identified in the reviewed product/Responsible AI pages, AI blog, Trust Center, privacy policy or subprocessor disclosure. Azure is identified as hosting/storage, not as the AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II assurance and ISO 27001 certification are claimed; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a standalone certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile reports no rounds, and the founder says the company is employee/founder-owned and has taken no outside funding.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding is reported; window assessed: 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live syndicated Global Enterprise Account Executive, Workplace Equity posting is dated 2026-11-03 and offers an Apply now link; official-board availability was not independently exposed.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-05-20, Trusaic announced an enhanced EU Pay Transparency Directive Transposition Monitor with a real-time interactive map, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Lynn Kaiser’s profile dates her Counsel & VP of Regulatory Affairs start to November 2025, and a January 2026 colleague post says she recently joined. The exact November start day is not given, so the 2025-11-09 cutoff cannot be resolved without guessing.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The account-executive job description explicitly says the global pipeline is managed and forecast using these systems.
